svg.title: The two-field determinant film has an internal momentum and two opposite external momenta. Its R internal average is normalized Haar average, namely stock F = [−π,π]4 F(k)d4k/(2π)4; its finite- period average is shopn F = n−4 P k F(2πk/n). The curvature picture called profitable F is one half of the internal average with the two external link and color indices in their specified order. The factor one half is the quadratic Taylor factorial. Translation invariance makes the actual Hessian entry zero unless its two Fourier momenta sum to zero, and otherwise that entry is the site count times the finite-period average of the film.
